'''Bland James Finlay''' [[Fellow of the Royal Society|FRS]] (16 March 1952 – 24 December 2021<ref name=":1">{{Cite journal |last=Fenchel |first=Tom |date=October 2022 |title=Bland James Finlay (March 16, 1952–December 24, 2021) |url=https://linkinghub.elsevier.com/retrieve/pii/S1434461022000517 |journal=Protist |language=en |volume=173 |issue=5 |article-number=125906 |doi=10.1016/j.protis.2022.125906|url-access=subscription }}</ref><ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=Bland Finlay |url=https://royalsociety.org/people/bland-finlay-11433/ |access-date=2022-07-18 |website=royalsociety.org}}</ref>) was a British [[biologist]].

==Career==

Finlay received his bachelor's and PhD degrees from the [[University of Stirling]]. He worked as a lecturer at [[University of Jos]] for a year, before moving to the [[Freshwater Biological Association]]'s laboratory at [[Windermere]] where he was based from 1978 to 2003.<ref name=":1" /> Many of his research studies were conducted at the nearby pond of [[Priest Pot]] in the [[Lake District]].<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Berninger |first=Ulrike-G. |date=December 2022 |title=Some Personal Memories of Bland J. Finlay and Work on Protists in "Priest Pot" |url=https://linkinghub.elsevier.com/retrieve/pii/S1434461022000554 |journal=Protist |language=en |volume=173 |issue=6 |article-number=125910 |doi=10.1016/j.protis.2022.125910|doi-access=free }}</ref> He then worked at the [[UK Centre for Ecology & Hydrology]] from 2003 to 2007.<ref name=":1" /> In 2007 he was appointed Professor of Microbial Ecology, [[Queen Mary, University of London]], before retiring in 2012.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.sbcs.qmul.ac.uk/staff/blandjfinlayfrs.html|title = Bland J Finlay - School of Biological and Behavioural Sciences}}</ref> His research focused on the ecology and physiology of single celled eukaryotic microbes ([[protist]]s), particularly those from [[Microaerophile|low-oxygen habitats]].<ref name=":0" />

==Selected works==
* [[Tom Fenchel]], Bland J. Finlay, ''Ecology and evolution in anoxic worlds'', Oxford University Press, 1995, {{ISBN|978-0-19-854838-6}}
* Bland J. Finlay, Global Dispersal of Free-Living Microbial Eukaryote Species. ''Science'' '''296''', 1061-1063 (2002). [https://doi.org/10.1126/science.1070710]
